name: workflow-manager
description: Quality-first, context-efficient, efficiency-biased workflow management with adaptive routing, lossless output guidance, compaction recovery, and dynamic subagent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Protect reasoning quality while managing context and agents.
interface.longDescription: Guides multi-step work without omitting required reasoning, evidence, correction, or verification; preserves oversized tool results for model reasoning; resumes acceptance state across compaction; and dynamically delegates positive-utility independent lanes.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow-manager to complete this task through the smallest relevant stages without omitting required reasoning, evidence, correction, or verification.
Correctness and acceptance evidence outrank context savings; preserve oversized results, checkpoint before compaction, and remove only redundant work or presentation.

For Complex/Extensive work, optimize expected wall-clock time: proactively delegate positive-utility read, write, test, research, or review lanes with clear ownership; treat caps as ceilings and serialize only conflicting shared build/device operations.
